longDescription: Image Slideshow turns the Ulanzi D200 center display into an offline rotating gallery. Choose a local folder of PNG, JPG, JPEG, or SVG images, set the interval and ordering, and let the plugin detect file changes automatically. Exact 458 x 196 images pass through unchanged; other sizes are center-cropped in memory without modifying the originals. Setup Large Display provides guided Install, Repair, and Restore operations with verified requests, backups, atomic profile updates, readback validation, rollback, and automatic Studio restart. SmallViewMode 2 keeps the center area in background-only mode so the clock does not reappear. The plugin runs locally without an account or cloud service and is currently compatible with Windows only. Special thanks to the author of https://github.com/chilleno/claude-deck for documenting the profile technique that made safe use of the D200 large display possible.
